answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock real collateral to act, so spinning up a nebula of fake identities means posting that bond for every one. An attacker cannot find a cheap haven in numbers, because the capital scales linearly with the fleet while honest agents reuse a single stake. Misbehavior burns the bond, turning each terrace of cloned personas into a mounting, unrecoverable cost rather than free leverage.
